summary: Fixing and testing bugs is highly valued; PRs run automated CI tests, but contributors must also test their own work and show evidence in the PR to improve chances of review and merge.
questions: Why should I test my Ansible pull request myself if CI runs tests?

answer_card.title: Why test your contributions
answer_card.answer_md: Bug fixes are prioritized over features, and testing others' PRs is valuable even for non-developers. CI (such as Azure Pipelines) runs automatically, but you should also **test locally and show evidence in the PR**; that makes review and merge more likely. For collections, see the collection testing docs.
